description: Expected alerts for mexc-futures-deal-replay.jsonl. Generated by C:/git/trade-capture/analysis/make_mexc_futures_fixture.py (FuturesDetector), independently of the Java code. Each fixture line is a capture record: r = local receive ms, v = venue, d = the push.deal frame. Replay every line in order with the clock at r; before each line, close every open sweep whose last fill arrived idleCloseMs or more earlier, in order of the contracts' first line. 'coalesced': alerts in emission order; closedBy says whether the idle close or a later deal closed the sweep, detectedAtMs is the r it closed at. 'coalescedOpenAtEnd': sweeps still open after the last line, never judged. 'filteredDeals': M=1 deals dropped. 'm1DealsThatWouldAlert': M=1 deals at or above their contract's threshold, which must not alert. 'idleSplits': deals that would have continued an idle-closed sweep. 'idleOnly': first trade ids of alerts that only the idle close emits within the window.
rule: futures: drop M=1; oldest first; same side, same t, next i, price equal or toward the aggressor; idle close on receive time
